title: KCP event_payload request (DESIGN.md §11.3, §11.4, §11.6.1 read family)
description: Read: never mutates authoritative or user-visible state and never carries meta (closed shape — a read carrying meta, hence an idempotency key, fails; §11.2, R0 KENV-01). Dereferences one event's externalized payload (the §11.3 payload_ref arm) by event id; access is authorized at read time and payload retention may be shorter than metadata retention by classification (§11.4). Derived shape (gap note KG28). Registry (shared_space_v1): surface external_client / principal; connector service (only for its mapped resources) (assurance: current login or workload identity). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

args.description: Exact target by the §11.3 envelope's event_id.

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).
